_comment: Captured from baselineRules.evaluateBaselineRules on branch agent/utility-checks-oregon-data at 5d9cb441 (= staging c659f0c5 + the one-line SLD read), BEFORE Oregon's state-named rules moved to data: per payload of the matrix in jurisdictionQcRules.test.ts (states x AHJ names x packages x code contexts), the first 16 hex of sha256(JSON.stringify(results)); and the whole rule catalogue. UPDATE_PIN=1 rewrites it from the current code (only for an intended change).

catalogue.name: Applicant vs utility account holder
catalogue.source: Utility interconnection practice (observed: application APP-111681 suspended)
catalogue.trigger: The name on the application differs from the account holder printed on the utility bill
catalogue.action: Add the applicant to the account, put the service in their name, or name the account holder on the application — before filing.

catalogue.name: Oregon residential NEM size screen
catalogue.trigger: Residential net metering facility over 25 kW DC
catalogue.action: Flag for non-standard NEM review or commercial/non-residential confirmation.

catalogue.name: Oregon Tier 1 export screen
catalogue.trigger: Export capacity over 25 kW or generation over 50 kW
catalogue.action: Flag likely Tier 2/3 utility review path before submission.

catalogue.name: Oregon NEM manual disconnect
catalogue.action: Confirm lockable load-break disconnect or documented utility exception.

catalogue.name: Oregon prescriptive snow limit
catalogue.trigger: Ground snow load over 70 psf or missing
catalogue.action: Route to engineered path or human structural review.

catalogue.name: Oregon prescriptive dead load limit
catalogue.trigger: PV system dead load over 4.5 psf or missing
catalogue.action: Route to engineered path or verify stamped structural basis.

catalogue.name: Oregon prescriptive roof framing
catalogue.trigger: Rafter/truss spacing missing or over 24 inches
catalogue.action: Require engineered path or verified framing exception.

catalogue.name: Oregon PV firefighter pathways
catalogue.source: Oregon BCD PV Pathways Technical Bulletin
catalogue.trigger: Rooftop PV with no pathway/site plan evidence
catalogue.action: Confirm site plan shows required firefighter access and escape pathways.

catalogue.name: Portland solar submittal documents
catalogue.action: Flag missing plan sheets before DevHub submission.

catalogue.name: Portland ready for issue status
catalogue.trigger: Pre-issuance complete / ready to issue / fees due
catalogue.action: Flag ready_for_issue and queue human fee/payment/download step.

catalogue.name: Pacific Power UL 1741 SB inverter settings
catalogue.jurisdictionScope: PacifiCorp states (OR/WA/CA Pacific Power; UT/ID/WY Rocky Mountain Power)
catalogue.trigger: Pacific Power project lacks UL 1741 SB / inverter settings evidence
catalogue.action: Confirm inverter spec/settings package before NEM submission.

catalogue.name: Pacific Power meter photo requirement
catalogue.jurisdictionScope: PacifiCorp states (OR/WA/CA Pacific Power; UT/ID/WY Rocky Mountain Power)
catalogue.trigger: Pacific Power project missing meter evidence

catalogue.name: PGE interconnection package
catalogue.trigger: PGE project missing SLD/site/spec package evidence
catalogue.action: Confirm SLD, site/plot plan, equipment specs, and utility bill/meter data.

catalogue.name: Utility application package
catalogue.utilityScope: Any utility with application requirements on file
catalogue.trigger: A recorded application requirement of the job's utility is not shown in the package
catalogue.action: Add the missing item to the utility application package before filing.

catalogue.name: Utility application requirements not researched
catalogue.utilityScope: Any utility with no requirement record
catalogue.source: Strictest common set of the researched utilities' applications
catalogue.trigger: The job's utility has no requirement record and the package lacks an item of the strictest common set
catalogue.action: Check the utility's own application requirements by hand and record them with their page and words.
